metadata.description: Google Stitch design skills — install the full toolkit or pick individual skills

plugins.name: stitch-skills
plugins.description: Full Google Stitch toolkit: projects, design systems, screens, iteration, component slicing, Storybook, and handoff to code

plugins.name: stitch-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end Google Stitch workflow orchestration: which tool to call, in what order, with what state

plugins.name: stitch-projects
plugins.description: Create, list, inspect, and delete Google Stitch projects, and resolve project/screen/instance identifiers

plugins.name: stitch-design-system
plugins.description: Build, apply, and export Google Stitch design systems: theme tokens, fonts, DESIGN.md in and out

plugins.name: stitch-screens
plugins.description: Generate Google Stitch screens from text prompts and survive the long-running generation protocol

plugins.name: stitch-iterate
plugins.description: Refine existing Google Stitch screens with targeted edits and explore alternatives with design variants

plugins.name: stitch-components
plugins.description: Download a Google Stitch screen HTML and slice it into reusable framework components

plugins.name: stitch-storybook
plugins.description: Set up Storybook, register Stitch components as stories, and compose pages from them

plugins.name: stitch-to-code
plugins.description: Turn Google Stitch screens and design tokens into production code that matches the host project stack
